CREATE SCHEMA usage_children

CREATE TABLE parent(discarded integer,a integer,b integer,n integer CONSTRAINT parent_required NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT parent_key PRIMARY KEY(a,b),CONSTRAINT repeated CHECK(n>0 AND n<10),CONSTRAINT fixed CHECK(true))

CREATE TABLE usage_children.child(id integer PRIMARY KEY,pa integer,pb integer,CONSTRAINT shared_fk FOREIGN KEY(pb,pa) REFERENCES parent(b,a))

CREATE TABLE checks(a integer,b integer,CONSTRAINT pair CHECK(a<b AND a>0),CONSTRAINT entire CHECK(checks.* IS NOT NULL),CONSTRAINT system_attribute CHECK(tableoid<>0))
CREATE TABLE quoted("Has Space" integer CONSTRAINT same_name CHECK("Has Space">0))
CREATE TABLE inherited() INHERITS(quoted)
CREATE TABLE partitioned(id integer,k integer,PRIMARY KEY(id,k),CHECK(k>0)) PARTITION BY RANGE(k)
CREATE TABLE leaf PARTITION OF partitioned FOR VALUES FROM(1) TO(10)
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER usage_wrapper
CREATE SERVER usage_server FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER usage_wrapper
CREATE FOREIGN TABLE external(n integer NOT NULL CONSTRAINT external_check CHECK(n>0)) SERVER usage_server
CREATE DOMAIN positive AS integer CONSTRAINT domain_check CHECK(VALUE>0)
